name: 88. Bedrock Converse images inside tool results for OpenAI and xAI models (converse-tool-result-images)
description:
AWS Converse rejects an image inside a toolResult for the OpenAI and xAI families (gpt-5.6, gpt-6-astra, grok-4.6) with 400 "This model doesn't support the image field for user messages", although the same image is accepted at the top level of a user message and gpt-5.6 reads it nested on the Responses API. Screenshot and browser tools return exactly that shape, so each such agent turn failed.

hoistToolResultImages runs in both Converse converters (chat and Responses). It moves each image out of its toolResult to follow the last toolResult in the same user message, keeping result order, and leaves the fixed text "Image attached below." in a toolResult it emptied, because an empty toolResult is its own 400. It is gated on supports_converse_tool_result_images, falling back to the OpenAI and xAI families; Claude, Nova and Llama 4 keep the nested shape (Llama 4 rejects the moved layout).

Cases pin: the Claude Code shape on the Anthropic route (placeholder text, and the model actually reading the moved image), parallel results on chat completions (all toolResults first, images in result order), the Responses converter, streaming, the xAI fallback branch, and a Claude control that must stay nested. All use the plain bedrock provider, so every request goes to Converse.
